summary: The ippon moment after a throw: uke lands flat on the back with the chin tucked and the left arm slapping the mat (ukemi); tori stands over uke, still holding and pulling up uke's right sleeve.

roles.l_arm: pulling hand still on uke's sleeve

partners.text: Uke in a blue judogi landing flat on the back, chin tucked to the chest so the head does not hit the mat, left arm slapping the tatami at about 45 degrees from the body, legs up from the throw.

rules.why: uke's chin tucked: the back of the head does not hit the mat (ukemi)
uke's free arm slaps the mat

text.action: the ippon moment: a judoka's opponent lands flat on the back after a throw
text.core: Tori stands over uke with knees bent and trunk leaning forward, the left hand still gripping the end of uke's right sleeve and pulling it up, the right arm released; uke lies flat on the back in front of tori's feet, chin tucked to the chest with the head off the mat, the left arm straight and slapping the tatami at about 45 degrees from the body, legs bent up from the throw.
cues: keep pulling the sleeve so uke lands safely
uke: chin to chest, slap the mat
the referee raises the arm high for ippon
kinetic: tatami shock wave and dust at the impact
referee's arm shooting up for ippon
avoid: both athletes in the same colour judogi
tori letting go of the sleeve
